title: Prove source-bound QQ16 installed return graph cap
body:
## Summary

```text
per owner: G = 2S + 43 + (3d²+3d+20) + R + 2s + 128
complete encoded snapshot: K = max(H, sum(G) + L)
```

Close PR4986's uniform encoded-graph obligation with a source-bound replacement-slot invariant using actual constructor/Ordinary inventories, scalar catalogues, Context lifetimes and packet slots. Preserve the inherited source and every return phase. Prepared by JoyboyBrian with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; predecessor notices and source closure are retained.

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR4986 assumed K=65536 on a finite trace; the same service owner grows from 5033 to 5054 edges at unchanged Tape count.
- **After:** derive K symbolically before input and calibrate the reduced caller at K=67783; all 49 algorithm validations, 24 returns and 36 exchanges preserve the unchanged complete receipt. Normal and optimized explicit checks pass, including stale-Context/stale-lease/cap rejection controls and a literal restore_context shape control. Metadata/pins, committed bytes, source-history and Git-free export integrity pass.

The encoded graph excludes Tape bodies, dict keys, set members and closure/generator internals. This is not a Python-memory or physical frontend theorem; F, scalar bit widths, the complete D* versus B* bill and supplier admission remain open. No production O73 replay or κ change.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** Two-way.

**Blast Radius:** Isolated.

Only a new scoped research package is added; selected records and frozen sources are unchanged.
